intro_line: A harbour capital where markets, mountains and colonial streets meet.
intro: Port Louis rewards visitors with a lively bazaar, waterfront promenades and easy access to the island's interior. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Metro Express light rail links suburbs to the city, daily 6 AM to 10 PM, roughly every 12-15 minutes.
Two bus stations: Immigration Square for north and east routes, Victoria Square for south and west routes.
Buses run frequently with few schedules; first around 6 AM, intercity last around 6 PM, city buses until 8 PM.
Intercity bus tickets cost about MUR 15-30; express and AC buses cost more.
Taxis within the city cost about MUR 10-50, a bit more at night; avoid rush hours.
Ride apps are limited; arrange taxis by phone or at ranks. Driving is chaotic, so park at the marina or hotel.

airports.name: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport
airports.note: Main international gateway, about 35 km straight-line southeast of the centre.
